core_rule: IPP01: Video product inconsistent with bound product

anti_false_positive.FP-02: Do not compare brand names/OCR text
anti_false_positive.FP-04: Compare ALL product images, not just main
anti_false_positive.FP-06: Bound product appearing = no_hit even with others

judgment_flow: Check physical show → not shown = no_hit (FP-11)
Compare video vs ALL product images

key_reminders.product_category: ONLY for exemption, NEVER for consistency
key_reminders.FP-11: Requires actual images, cannot apply when missing
key_reminders.consistency: Both packaging AND content must match for no_hit
